symptom: Repair v9 passed the candidate static chain and isolated validate-candidates, but its 300s / 3-seed all-Bot smoke matrix still failed: CowardBot was too low at 0.0%, GreedyXpBot remained too high at 100.0%, and RouteBot remained too high at 66.7%. Idle, Random, Kite, Tank, BossHunter, and ZoneControl stayed within target bands.
root_cause: The narrow economy nerf reduced candy-crystal-lens and star-spoon scaling but did not remove the safe Greedy/Route survival pattern. At the same time, the weaker pickup/XP economy hurt Coward's ability to recover from early and mid pressure. This indicates the remaining problem is not just passive economy magnitude; it likely involves fixed-route safety, XP access geometry, or localized wave pressure windows that allow Greedy and Route to survive while punishing lower-skill pathing.
fix: Do not promote v9 or run the 10-seed expansion. The next candidate should avoid further broad economy nerfs and instead target the safe-route exploit more directly: adjust localized wave timing, enemy mix, or map/route pressure so Greedy and Route lose guaranteed safe collection paths while Coward keeps at least one recoverable seed. Preserve v9's passes for Idle, Random, Kite, Tank, BossHunter, and ZoneControl.
validation: Create v10 as a generated candidate only, rerun the full candidate static chain, then rerun the same 300s / 3-seed all-Bot smoke matrix. Passing requires CowardBot 10%-35%, GreedyXpBot 25%-55%, and RouteBot 10%-35% without regressing Idle, Random, Kite, Tank, BossHunter, or ZoneControl out of their target bands.
